entities.name: Charlotta Frölich
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charlotta Frölich was a Swedish writer, historian, agronomist and poet. She sometimes used the pseudonym Lotta Triven. She published poems, stories, and work about political and scientific subjects. She was the first female to be published by the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences.
